detailed_descriptions.en: Humanity will do everything to survive. You will make sure they don’t. Unleash disasters, plagues, and war, and wipe them out before they escape to the Ark. HOW YOU PLAY • Deploy disasters, plagues, and warfare across the globe • Gain resources from destruction and expand your reach • Combine events to trigger devastating chain reactions • Upgrade your abilities and shape your strategy • Stop humanity’s desperate attempts to survive HUMANITY FIGHTS BACK They won’t go down without a fight. • Governments mobilize to contain your disasters and secure key territories • Scientists race to develop countermeasures and slow your expansion • Global aid efforts stabilize regions and limit the damage you cause • As the end approaches, humanity begins constructing a space Ark to escape UNLEASH CATASTROPHES There are many ways to end the world. Find yours. • Trigger over 10 unique disasters, from plagues to global warfare • Combine events to create powerful and unpredictable chain reactions • Strike regions precisely with active abilities • Experiment and discover the fastest path to extinction MASTER YOUR STRATEGY Every decision matters. • Manage resources to fuel your expansion • Choose your upgrade path and define your playstyle • Unlock new abilities and strengthen your strategy • Adapt as humanity evolves and pushes back • Timing, positioning, and combinations make all the difference GLOBAL DESTRUCTION, ENDLESS STRATEGIES No two runs play the same. • 18 campaign missions across 4 difficulty levels • 28 challenge scenarios with unique rules • Over 70 perks and upgrades to unlock • 25+ achievements to complete • Dozens of hours of replayable destruction

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Humanity will do everything to survive.

You will make sure they don’t.

Unleash disasters, plagues, and war, and wipe them out before they escape to the Ark.

HOW YOU PLAY

• Deploy disasters, plagues, and warfare across the globe

• Gain resources from destruction and expand your reach

• Combine events to trigger devastating chain reactions

• Upgrade your abilities and shape your strategy

• Stop humanity’s desperate attempts to survive

HUMANITY FIGHTS BACK

They won’t go down without a fight.

• Governments mobilize to contain your disasters and secure key territories

• Scientists race to develop countermeasures and slow your expansion

• Global aid efforts stabilize regions and limit the damage you cause

• As the end approaches, humanity begins constructing a space Ark to escape

UNLEASH CATASTROPHES

There are many ways to end the world. Find yours.

• Trigger over 10 unique disasters, from plagues to global warfare

• Combine events to create powerful and unpredictable chain reactions

• Strike regions precisely with active abilities

• Experiment and discover the fastest path to extinction

MASTER YOUR STRATEGY

Every decision matters.

• Manage resources to fuel your expansion

• Choose your upgrade path and define your playstyle

• Unlock new abilities and strengthen your strategy

• Adapt as humanity evolves and pushes back

• Timing, positioning, and combinations make all the difference

GLOBAL DESTRUCTION, ENDLESS STRATEGIES

No two runs play the same.

• 18 campaign missions across 4 difficulty levels

• 28 challenge scenarios with unique rules

• Over 70 perks and upgrades to unlock

• 25+ achievements to complete

• Dozens of hours of replayable destruction
